description: Get the full Parfumo record of one perfume: brand, year, perfumers, note pyramid, main accords, average ratings (scent, longevity, sillage, bottle, value) and the community classification by season, occasion, type and audience. Use after parfumo_search_perfumes. Returns one structured record with a `warnings` list when a secondary part could not be read.

perfume.description: Perfume identifier: the `id` returned by other tools (e.g. "Dior/Sauvage_Eau_de_Toilette") or its Parfumo URL.

name: parfumo_get_perfume

ClassGroup.description: One group of the community classification.

group.description: Group name as shown by Parfumo: `Type`, `Occasion`, `Season`, `Audience & Style`.

votes.description: Number of votes behind the chart, when shown.

ClassShare.description: One slice of a community classification chart.

EntityRef.description: Reference to a brand, perfumer or fragrance note.

numeric_id.description: Numeric Parfumo identifier (b_id, pf_id or note id) when the page exposes it.

RatingScore.description: Community average on one rating scale.

classification.description: Community classification (type, season, occasion, audience, style).

description.description: Editorial description shown on the page.

gender.description: Target gender as stated by Parfumo (`men`, `women`, `unisex`).

ranking.description: Rank label shown on the page (e.g. `Ranked 30 in Men's Perfume`).

ratings.description: Community averages (scent, durability, sillage, bottle, pricing).

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems: optional parts that could not be loaded.
